name: junos-evo-ptx10008
description: Captured from a Juniper PTX10008 running Junos EVO (anonymized): the FPC row and its PIC row both report parent 0, and the optics report the PIC as parent. Each FPC, PIC and optic description keeps its '@ fpc/pic/port' locator. Other slot rows (PSM, SIB, CB, fan tray) report their slot number as parent.
